assumptions: Fluid composition assumption: Line 2750.001.6 fluid code 8503 and piping class 10HB25T10B1 not defined in project documents (search_documents for K2750/C02/8503/10HB25T10B1/BASF/DEXPI returned no pages). Data sheet states no process conditions on drawing. Model uses Water+Ethanol with NRTL as generic organic-water proxy to demonstrate column hydraulics; all temperatures/duties/compositions illustrative and must be replaced with actual fluid 8503 assay.

Operating condition assumption: No feed temperature, pressure, flow or product specs on P&ID or data sheet. Assumed feed 1000 kg/h, 85 C, 3 Bar, x Water 0.3 / Ethanol 0.7; reflux ratio 1.5, reboiler product 3.0 mol/s; condenser total. No measured values to calibrate against - calibration section reports design-limit utilisation only.

Column staging assumption: Height 14000 mm with tray spacing 0.5 m allows ~28 theoretical trays max. Model uses 15 stages feed stage 8 efficiency 0.7 for numerical stability and to fit within shell; actual internals (trays vs packing, stage count) not on DEXPI export.

Diameter conflict/assumption: K 2750 Chamber 1 InsideDiameter 500 mm vs KX 2750 ColumnSection InsideDiameter 600 mm - both Material 1.4571. Interpreted as single column with two diameters (enlarged section). Model uses conservative 0.5 m for flood screening; DWSIM estimates 0.555 m required at assumed rate, indicating tight fit - to be checked once actual vapour loads known. Listed as assumption per instruction to note site/P&ID conflicts.

Exclusions justified: Valves *at P3*/OperatedValve and *at P4*/OperatedValve and lines *at P3*/*at P4* are instrument root valves to BlindFlange -> PI(Z) 275003A/B -> PIS+Z+A 275003 pressure measurement loops, not process flow lines; no connection to off-page flow. Closed per check_coverage guidance and not modelled as process valves. No data_quality warnings present on latest P&ID export.

Topology assumption: Recirculation/utility loops: none on this DEXPI C02 extract. Both documented connections carry normal flow and are modelled: VENT_INT via *at N3*/*C2* to open-out (*at N3*) and bottoms to 2750.001.6 off-page connector via PipeReducer. No recycle unit needed (no temperature-by-mixing loop; no closed coolant loop at known supply temperature).

Limits assumption: All limits taken from P&ID design_limits (max_P 6 Bar, max_T 150 C for K2750 and derived for streams 2750.001.6/*at N3*/VENT_INT/FEED). No pump, exchanger area, tank residence, relief or utility supply ratings appear on this column-only P&ID extract; none added. Later alternatives must not raise these 6 Bar/150 C ratings per instruction.
